original.target_description: Study 1b, adult community sample recruited on town green; Pearson correlation of UCLA loneliness with the standardized bathing frequency/duration/temperature physical warmth extraction index.

n.quote: a community sample of participants (16 female, 25 male) was recruited on the town green of a small New England city.
n.sample_role: recruited participants; analytic sample not explicitly established
n.exclusions: No analytic exclusions or item-specific missingness reported.

es.quote: the overall “physical warmth extraction” index variable was significantly correlated with chronic levels of loneliness (r ⫽ .37, p ⫽ .017)

p.quote: the overall “physical warmth extraction” index variable was significantly correlated with chronic levels of loneliness (r ⫽ .37, p ⫽ .017)

replication.target_description: College students; UCLA Loneliness Scale version 3 and composite Physical Warmth Index. Near-exact replication; bathing response options differ from original.
